api: SurveyMonkey REST API v3 and SCIM API v2 (https://api.surveymonkey.com); provider artifact version: REST API v3 plus SCIM API v2
scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 135 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official html_reference artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion against SurveyMonkey's rendered static API reference fetched from the official developer portal iframe. All 135 documented operations are covered: 82 GET endpoints as streams (REST v3 resources plus SCIM v2 resources) and 53 POST/PUT/PATCH endpoints as write actions. New non-legacy streams use passthrough projection with minimal catalog schemas so the engine preserves the live API response fields instead of pretending a hand-maintained schema is exhaustive. No documented DELETE endpoints were present in the fetched reference.
